items.title: Scenes
items.text: Backgrounds that move, and that visitors can play with: a click or a tap anywhere on the page. Starfield flight and Bubbles are for everyone; Pipes, Pond and Lava lamp come with Glow. They're in your homepage's Page tab, under Background.

items.title: Songs that play by themselves
items.text: A homepage's first song now starts quietly when someone opens it, like MySpace did, and every player has a volume slider and bars that dance to the music. Rather it didn't? There's a switch in Settings.

items.title: Jump to the newest
items.text: Scrolled a long way up in a chat? A bar takes you straight back down to the newest messages.

items.title: Shift to delete
items.text: Hold Shift over one of your messages and a bin shows up: one click deletes it, without being asked.
